title: Glare Is Better
description: The Glare should have won the 2021 mob vote, so this replaces the texture for the Allay with the Glare.
body:
I made this texture pack so I don't have to look at that abomination, the allay.

The model and textures were all done by me (AronTries)

**you need [Optifine](https://optifine.net/downloads) or [Entity model features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) and [Entity texture features](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures). If none of these are installed, the Texture pack will not work!!!**

Do not reupload this without my permission.
